notes_for_editor: Only the tnlandforms list names this site. The name is the compiler's label (the page says names for towers 73 and above were made up). Searches returned USGS stream gauges named Hurricane Creek in Jeff Davis County and a Hazlehurst antenna structure; neither is a lookout, so neither is used. Could not read the GFC history page (timeout). The list's author is not named on the page, so the story does not credit one. Searches found no build, staffing, fire or removal record.
